_how: Copy this to tools/viewer-real-media-cases.json (gitignored: it holds the links from your own library) and put in links you actually have. Each case: key (label in the output), note (why this one is interesting), url, how ('clip' = clip_url into the vault, 'video' = import a local file and store it), cookie (optional: 'ehentai' or 'f95', read from the file named in GOON_EH_COOKIE / GOON_F95_COOKIE). Keep the order you measured: --reuse re-measures the vault an earlier run filled, and items are opened by index.

cases.note: the case Fit used to leave at its own pixels: a jpeg whose height is below the stage's
bigger than the stage in both directions, so Fit has to shrink
far smaller than the stage and animated: the second case in the 2026-11-23 report
one page of a gallery on a host that needs a cookie
a video inside the vault: the third case, where the tile had claimed the size
